touchpoints.name: Panel estado alerta registro
touchpoints.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM PageView WHERE appName LIKE 'web-%' FACET name SINCE 24 hours ago

touchpoints.name: Motor transacción servicios evento alerta
touchpoints.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE entityGuid IS NOT NULL SINCE 1 hour ago

touchpoints.name: Módulo usuario agente registro
touchpoints.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM SyntheticCheck FACET appName SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Transacción respuesta rendimiento
touchpoints.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE error IS true FACET name SINCE 30 minutes ago
